answer_1.quote: To summarize, our major contributions are: • We propose to model conversation history using history semantic graph... By applying graph neural network on the history semantic graph, the model can capture the complex interaction between the entities and improve its understanding of the conversation history... The model generates sequence-formatted logical forms.
answer_1.outputs: Logical forms (sequence of actions representing queries over the knowledge graph)

answer_2.quote: We use the same metrics as employed by the authors of the CSQA dataset as well as the previous baselines. F1 score is used to evaluate the question whose answer is comprised of entities, while Accuracy is used to measure the question whose answer is a number or a boolean number.
